verses.en: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Levi foram: Gérson, Coate, e Merari.
verses.en_web: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom e Uziel.
verses.en_web: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.en: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Anrão: Arão, Moisés, e Miriã. E os filhos de Arão foram: Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar, e Itamar.
verses.en_web: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.en: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
verses.pt: E Eleazar gerou a Fineias, Fineias gerou a Abisua;
verses.en_web: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
verses.en_bbe: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas; Phinehas was the father of Abishua;

verses.en: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
verses.pt: Abisua gerou a Buqui, Buqui gerou a Uzi;
verses.en_web: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.
verses.en_bbe: And Abishua was the father of Bukki, and Bukki was the father of Uzzi,

verses.en: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
verses.pt: Uzi gerou a Zeraías, Zeraías gerou a Meraiote;
verses.en_web: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.
verses.en_bbe: And Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, and Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth;

verses.en: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.pt: Meraiote gerou a Amarias, Amarias gerou a Aitube;
verses.en_web: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
verses.en_bbe: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, and Amariah was the father of Ahitub,

verses.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
verses.pt: Aitube gerou a Zadoque, Zadoque gerou a Aimaaz;
verses.en_web: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.
verses.en_bbe: And Ahitub was the father of Zadok, and Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,

verses.en: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
verses.pt: Aimaaz gerou a Azarias, Azarias gerou a Joanã;
verses.en_web: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.
verses.en_bbe: And Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, and Azariah was the father of Johanan,

verses.en: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
verses.pt: Joanã gerou a Azarias (este é o que administrou o sacerdócio na casa que Salomão edificou em Jerusalém);
verses.en_web: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And Johanan was the father of Azariah, (he was priest in the house which Solomon put up in Jerusalem:)

verses.en: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.pt: Azarias gerou a Amarias, Amarias gerou a Aitube;
verses.en_web: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
verses.en_bbe: And Azariah was the father of Amariah, and Amariah was the father of Ahitub,

verses.en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
verses.pt: Aitube gerou a Zadoque, Zadoque gerou a Salum;
verses.en_web: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.
verses.en_bbe: And Ahitub was the father of Zadok, and Zadok was the father of Shallum,

verses.en: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
verses.pt: Salum gerou a Hilquias, Hilquias gerou a Azarias;
verses.en_web: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.
verses.en_bbe: And Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, and Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,

verses.en: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
verses.pt: Azarias gerou a Seraías, Seraías, gerou a Jeozadaque.
verses.en_web: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.
verses.en_bbe: And Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak;

verses.en: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.pt: E Jeozadaque foi levado cativo quando O SENHOR levou Judá e a Jerusalém como prisioneiros, pela mão de Nabucodonosor.
verses.en_web: Jehozadak went into captivity, when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.en_bbe: And Jehozadak went as a prisoner when the Lord took away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.en: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Levi foram: Gérson, Coate, e Merari.
verses.en_web: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.en: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Gérson: Libni, e Simei.
verses.en_web: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom, e Uziel.
verses.en_web: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Merari: Mali, e Musi. Estas são as famílias de Levi, segundo seus pais.
verses.en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites listed by the names of their fathers.

verses.en: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.pt: De Gérson: seu filho Libni, seu filho Jaate, seu filho Zima.
verses.en_web: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.en_bbe: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

verses.en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
verses.pt: Seu filho Joabe, seu filho Ido, seu filho Zerá, e seu filho Jeaterai.
verses.en_web: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
verses.en_bbe: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.

verses.en: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.pt: Os filhos de Coate foram: seu filho Aminadabe, seu filho Corá, seu filho Assir,
verses.en_web: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

verses.en: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.pt: Seu filho Elcana, seu filho Ebiasafe, seu filho Assir,
verses.en_web: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
verses.en_bbe: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

verses.en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.pt: Seu filho Taate, seu filho Uriel, seu filho Uzias, e seu filho Saul.
verses.en_web: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.en_bbe: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

verses.en: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.pt: E os filhos Elcana foram: Amasai e Aimote.
verses.en_web: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

verses.en: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
verses.pt: Quanto a Elcana, os filhos de Elcana foram: seu filho Zofai, seu filho Naate,
verses.en_web: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
verses.en_bbe: Elkanah his son: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

verses.en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.pt: Seu filho Eliabe, seu filho Jeroão, e seu filho Elcana.
verses.en_web: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
verses.en_bbe: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son, Samuel his son.

verses.en: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Samuel foram: o primogênito Vasni, e Abias.
verses.en_web: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Samuel: the oldest Joel, and the second Abiah.

verses.en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.pt: Os filhos de Merari: Mali, seu filho Libni, seu filho Simei, seu filho Uzá,
verses.en_web: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

verses.en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.pt: Seu filho Simeia, seu filho Hagias, e seu filho Asaías.
verses.en_web: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.en_bbe: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

verses.en: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
verses.pt: Estes, pois, são os que Davi constituiu para o ofício da música da casa do Senhor, depois que a arca teve repouso.
verses.en_web: These are they whom David set over the service of song in Yahweh’s house, after the ark came to rest there.
verses.en_bbe: And these are those whom David made responsible for the music in the house of the Lord, after the ark had rest.

verses.en: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
verses.pt: E eles serviam diante da tenda do tabernáculo da congregação com cânticos, até que Salomão edificou a casa do SENHOR em Jerusalém; e estiveram segundo seu costume em seu serviço.
verses.en_web: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.
verses.en_bbe: They gave worship with songs before the House of the Tent of meeting, till Solomon put up the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; and they took their places for their work in their regular order.

verses.en: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
verses.pt: Estes, pois, foram os que ali estavam com seus filhos: dos filhos dos coatitas, Hemã, o cantor, filho de Joel, filho de Samuel,
verses.en_web: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
verses.en_bbe: And these are those who did this work, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman, who made melody, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

verses.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.pt: Filho de Elcana, filho de Jeroão, filho de Eliel, filho de Toá,
verses.en_web: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

verses.en: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.pt: Filho de Zufe, filho de Elcana, filho Maate, filho de Amasai,
verses.en_web: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

verses.en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.pt: Filho de Elcana, filho de Joel, filho de Azarias, filho de Sofonias,
verses.en_web: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

verses.en: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.pt: Filho de Taate, filho de Assir, filho de Ebiasafe, filho de Corá,
verses.en_web: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

verses.en: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.pt: Filho de Izar, filho de Coate, filho de Levi, filho de Israel.
verses.en_web: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

verses.en: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.pt: E seu irmão Asafe estava à sua direita; Asafe era, filho de Berequias, filho de Simeia,
verses.en_web: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.en_bbe: And his brother Asaph, whose place was at his right hand, Asaph, the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

verses.en: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
verses.pt: Filho de Micael, filho de Baaseias, filho de Malquias,
verses.en_web: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

verses.en: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.pt: Filho de Etni, filho de Zerá, filho de Adaías,
verses.en_web: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

verses.en: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.pt: Filho de Etã, filho de Zima, filho de Simei;
verses.en_web: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

verses.en: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.pt: Filho de Jaate, filho de Gérson, filho de Levi.
verses.en_web: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.en_bbe: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

verses.en: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.pt: E seus irmãos, os filhos de Merari, estavam à esquerda; eram eles: Etã, filho de Quisi, filho de Abdi, filho de Maluque,
verses.en_web: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.en_bbe: And on the left their brothers, the sons of Merari: Ethan, the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

verses.en: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.pt: Filho de Hasabias, filho de Amazias, filho de Hilquias,
verses.en_web: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.en: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
verses.pt: Filho de Anzi, filho de Bani, filho de Semer,
verses.en_web: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
verses.en_bbe: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

verses.en: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.pt: Filho de Mali, filho de Musi, filho de Merari, filho de Levi.
verses.en_web: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.en_bbe: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

verses.en: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.pt: E seus irmãos, os Levitas, foram postos para todo o serviço do tabernáculo da casa de Deus.
verses.en_web: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And their brothers the Levites were responsible for all the work of the Tent of the house of God.

verses.en: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.pt: E Arão e seus filhos ofereciam incenso sobre o altar do holocausto e sobre o altar do incenso, para toda a obra do lugar santíssimo, e para fazer expiação sobre Israel, conforme tudo quanto Moisés, servo de Deus, havia mandado.
verses.en_web: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.en_bbe: But Aaron and his sons made offerings on the altar of burned offering, and on the altar of perfume, for all the work of the most holy place, and to take away the sin of Israel, doing everything ordered by Moses, the servant of God.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.pt: E estes foram os filhos de Arão: seu filho Eleazar, seu filho Fineias, seu filho Abisua,
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.en_bbe: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

verses.en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.pt: Seu filho Buqui, seu filho Uzi, seu filho Zeraías,
verses.en_web: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.en_bbe: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

verses.en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.pt: Seu filho Meraiote, seu filho Amarias, seu filho Aitube,
verses.en_web: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.en_bbe: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

verses.en: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.pt: Seu filho Zadoque, e seu filho Aimaaz.
verses.en_web: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
verses.en_bbe: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

verses.en: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
verses.pt: E estas foram suas habitações, conforme seus acampamentos e seus termos, dos filhos de Arão da família dos coatitas, porque eles foram sorteados.
verses.en_web: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
verses.en_bbe: Now these are their living-places, the limits inside which they were to put up their tents: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, because they had the first selection,

verses.en: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.pt: Deram-lhes, pois, a Hebrom na terra de Judá, e seus campos ao redor dela.
verses.en_web: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its suburbs around it;
verses.en_bbe: To them they gave Hebron and its outskirts in the land of Judah;

verses.en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.pt: Porém o território da cidade e suas aldeias foram dadas a Calebe, filho de Jefoné.
verses.en_web: but the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.en_bbe: But the open country of the town, and the small places round it, they gave to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

verses.en: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
verses.pt: E aos filhos de Arão deram as seguintes cidades de refúgio: Hebrom, e Libna com seus campos; Jathir e Estemoa com seus campos;
verses.en_web: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its suburbs, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And to the sons of Aaron they gave Hebron, the town to which men might go in flight and be safe, and Libnah with its outskirts, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its outskirts,

verses.en: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
verses.pt: Hilém com seus campos; Debir com seus campos;
verses.en_web: Hilen with its suburbs, Debir with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And Hilen with its outskirts, Debir with its outskirts,

verses.en: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs:
verses.pt: Asã com seus campos; e a Bete-Semes com seus campos;
verses.en_web: Ashan with its suburbs, and Beth Shemesh with its suburbs;
verses.en_bbe: And Ashan with its outskirts, and Beth-shemesh with its outskirts;

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.pt: E da tribo de Benjamim, a Geba com seus campos; Alemete com seus campos; e Anatote com seus campos. Todas as suas cidades, repartidas por suas famílias, foram treze cidades.
verses.en_web: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its suburbs, Allemeth with its suburbs, and Anathoth with its suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.en_bbe: And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its outskirts, and Alemeth with its outskirts, and Anathoth with its outskirts. All their towns among their families were thirteen towns.

verses.en: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
verses.pt: Mas aos filhos de Coate, que restaram da família daquela tribo, deram por sorteio dez cidades da meia tribo de Manassés.
verses.en_web: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.en_bbe: And to the rest of the sons of Kohath there were given by the Lord's decision ten towns out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim and out of the tribe of Dan and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.en: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.pt: E aos filhos de Gérson, segundo suas famílias, deram treze cidades da tribo de Issacar, da tribo de Aser, da tribo de Naftali, e da tribo de Manassés, em Basã.
verses.en_web: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.en_bbe: And to the sons of Gershom, by their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen towns.

verses.en: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.pt: E aos filhos de Merari, segundo suas famílias, deram por sorteio doze cidades da tribo de Rúben, da tribo de Gade, e da tribo de Zebulom.
verses.en_web: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.en_bbe: And to the sons of Merari, by their families, twelve towns were given by the Lord's decision, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

verses.en: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
verses.pt: Assim os filhos de Israel deram aos Levitas estas cidades com seus campos.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their suburbs.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the towns with their outskirts.

verses.en: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
verses.pt: E deram-lhes por sorteio, da tribo dos filhos de Judá, da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, e da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, estas cidades, as quais mencionaram por seus nomes.
verses.en_web: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave by the Lord's decision out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these towns whose names are given.

verses.en: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.pt: E quanto ao resto das famílias dos filhos de Coate deram-lhes cidades com seus termos da tribo de Efraim.
verses.en_web: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.en_bbe: And to the families of the sons of Kohath were given towns by the Lord's decision out of the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.en: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E deram-lhes das cidades de refúgio, a Siquém e seus campos nas montanhas de Efraim, e a Gezer com seus campos,
verses.en_web: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its suburbs; Gezer also with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And they gave them the town to which men might go in flight and be safe, Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim with its outskirts, and Gezer with its outskirts,

verses.en: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs,
verses.pt: A Jocmeão com seus campos, a Bete-Horom com seus campos,
verses.en_web: Jokmeam with its suburbs, Beth Horon with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And Jokmeam with its outskirts, and Beth-horon with its outskirts,

verses.en: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs:
verses.pt: A Aijalom com seus campos, e a Gate-Rimom com seus campos;
verses.en_web: Aijalon with its suburbs, Gath Rimmon with its suburbs;
verses.en_bbe: And Aijalon with its outskirts, and Gath-rimmon with its outskirts;

verses.en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
verses.pt: Da meia tribo de Manassés, a Aner com seus campos, e a Bileã com seus campos, para os que restaram da família dos filhos de Coate.
verses.en_web: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its suburbs, and Bileam with its suburbs, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
verses.en_bbe: And out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its outskirts, and Bileam with its outskirts, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

verses.en: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
verses.pt: Aos filhos de Gérson deram da família da meia tribo de Manassés, a Golã em Basã com seus campos e a Astarote com seus campos;
verses.en_web: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its suburbs, and Ashtaroth with its suburbs;
verses.en_bbe: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its outskirts, and Ashtaroth with its outskirts;

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E da tribo de Issacar, a Quedes com seus campos, a Daberate com seus campos,
verses.en_web: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its suburbs, Daberath with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its outskirts, and Daberath with its outskirts,

verses.en: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
verses.pt: A Ramote com seus campos, e a Aném com seus campos;
verses.en_web: Ramoth with its suburbs, and Anem with its suburbs;
verses.en_bbe: And Ramoth with its outskirts, and Anem with its outskirts;

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E da tribo de Aser a Masal com seus campos, a Abdom com seus campos,
verses.en_web: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its suburbs, Abdon with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its outskirts, and Abdon with its outskirts,

verses.en: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
verses.pt: A Hucoque com seus campos, e a Reobe com seus campos.
verses.en_web: Hukok with its suburbs, and Rehob with its suburbs;
verses.en_bbe: And Hukok with its outskirts, and Rehob with its outskirts;

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
verses.pt: E da tribo de Naftali, a Quedes na Galileia com seus campos, a Hamom com seus campos, e a Quiriataim com seus campos.
verses.en_web: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its suburbs, Hammon with its suburbs, and Kiriathaim with its suburbs.
verses.en_bbe: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its outskirts, and Hammon with its outskirts, and Kiriathaim with its outskirts.

verses.en: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun. Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
verses.pt: E aos que restaram dos filhos de Merari, deram da tribo de Zebulom, a Rimono com seus campos, e a Tabor com seus campos;
verses.en_web: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its suburbs, Tabor with its suburbs;
verses.en_bbe: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its outskirts, Tabor with its outskirts;

verses.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E dalém do Jordão de Jericó, ao oriente do Jordão, deram da tribo de Rúben, a Bezer no deserto com seus campos; a Jaza com seus campos.
verses.en_web: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with its suburbs, and Jahzah with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And on the other side of Jordan, at Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the waste land with its outskirts, and Jahzah with its outskirts,

verses.en: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
verses.pt: A Quedemote com seus campos, e a Mefaate com seus campos;
verses.en_web: Kedemoth with its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs;
verses.en_bbe: And Kedemoth with its outskirts, and Mephaath with its outskirts;

verses.en: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.pt: E da tribo de Gade, a Ramote em Gileade com seus campos, a Maanaim com seus campos,
verses.en_web: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its suburbs, Mahanaim with its suburbs,
verses.en_bbe: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its outskirts, and Mahanaim with its outskirts,

verses.en: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
verses.pt: A Hesbom com seus campos, e a Jazer com seus campos.
verses.en_web: Heshbon with its suburbs, and Jazer with its suburbs.
verses.en_bbe: And Heshbon with its outskirts, and Jazer with its outskirts.
